    StringTokenizer st;

    int h, w;
    int n;
    long[] adj;
    long best;

    void go() throws Exception {
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        h = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        w = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        compute();
    }

    void compute() {
        n = w * h;
        adj = new long[n];
        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
            for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int x2 = x + dx[k];
                    int y2 = y + dy[k];
                    if (x2 >= 0 && x2 < w && y2 >= 0 && y2 < h) {
                        adj[y * w + x] |= 1L << (y2 * w + x2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        best = (1L << n) - 1;
        search(0, 0, 0);
        out.println((n - Long.bitCount(best)) + "");
        out.flush();
    }

    void search(long chosen, long removed, long covered) {
        if (Long.bitCount(chosen) >= Long.bitCount(best)) return;
        if (covered == ((1L << n) - 1)) {
            if (Long.bitCount(chosen) < Long.bitCount(best)) best = chosen;
            return;
        }

        int k = -1;
        int maxUncovered = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if ((removed >>> i & 1) == 1) continue;
            if ((covered >>> i & 1) == 1) {
                long uncovNei = adj[i] & ~covered;
                int cnt = Long.bitCount(uncovNei);
                if (cnt == 1 && (uncovNei & ~removed) != 0) {
                    search(chosen, removed | (1L << i), covered);
                    return;
                } else if (cnt == 0) {
                    search(chosen, removed | (1L << i), covered);
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                long notRemNei = adj[i] & ~removed;
                int cnt = Long.bitCount(notRemNei);
                if (cnt == 1) {
                    int j = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(notRemNei);
                    search(chosen | (1L << j), removed | (1L << i) | (1L << j), covered | (1L << j) | adj[j]);
                    return;
                } else if (cnt == 0) {
                    search(chosen | (1L << i), removed | (1L << i), covered | (1L << i) | adj[i]);

            if (uncovCount > maxUncovered) {
                maxUncovered = uncovCount;

    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    int h, w, n;
    long[] g;
    long best;
    long all;

    void run() {
        h = sc.nextInt();
        w = sc.nextInt();
        solve();
    }

    void solve() {
        n = w * h;
        g = new long[n];
        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

                    int x2 = x + dx[k];
                    int y2 = y + dy[k];
                    if (x2 >= 0 && x2 < w && y2 >= 0 && y2 < h) {
                        g[y * w + x] |= 1L << (y2 * w + x2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        all = (1L << n) - 1;
        best = all;
        iterative();
        System.out.println((n - Long.bitCount(best)) + "");
    }

    void iterative() {
        Deque<Frame> stack = new ArrayDeque<Frame>();
        stack.push(new Frame(0, 0, 0, 0, -1));
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Frame f = stack.peek();
            if (f.action == 0) {
                if (Long.bitCount(f.choosed) >= Long.bitCount(best)) {
                    stack.pop();
                    continue;
                }
                if (f.covered == all) {
                    if (Long.bitCount(f.choosed) < Long.bitCount(best)) best = f.choosed;
                    stack.pop();
                    continue;
                }
                long remained = ~f.removed & all;
                int k = -1;
                int maxUncovered = -1;
                boolean special = false;
                for (long r = remained; r != 0; r &= r - 1) {
                    int i = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(r);
                    if ((f.covered >>> i & 1) == 1) {
                        long uncovNei = g[i] & ~f.covered;
                        int cnt = Long.bitCount(uncovNei);
                        if (cnt == 0) {
                            stack.push(new Frame(f.choosed, f.removed | (1L << i), f.covered, 0, -1));
                            f.action = 1;
                            special = true;
                            break;
                        } else if (cnt == 1 && (uncovNei & ~f.removed) != 0) {
                            stack.push(new Frame(f.choosed, f.removed | (1L << i), f.covered, 0, -1));
                            f.action = 1;
                            special = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    } else {
                        long notRemNei = g[i] & ~f.removed;
                        int cnt = Long.bitCount(notRemNei);
                        if (cnt == 0) {
                            long newChoosed = f.choosed | (1L << i);
                            long newRemoved = f.removed | (1L << i);
                            long newCovered = f.covered | (1L << i) | g[i];
                            stack.push(new Frame(newChoosed, newRemoved, newCovered, 0, -1));
                            f.action = 1;
                            special = true;
                            break;
                        } else if (cnt == 1) {
                            int j = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(notRemNei);
                            long newChoosed = f.choosed | (1L << j);
                            long newRemoved = f.removed | (1L << i) | (1L << j);
                            long newCovered = f.covered | (1L << j) | g[j];
                            stack.push(new Frame(newChoosed, newRemoved, newCovered, 0, -1));
                            f.action = 1;
                            special = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    int uncovCount = Long.bitCount(g[i] & ~f.covered);
                    if (uncovCount > maxUncovered) {
                        maxUncovered = uncovCount;
                        k = i;
                    }
                }
                if (special) continue;
                if (k == -1) {
                    stack.pop();
                    continue;
                }
                f.k = k;
                f.action = 2;
                long newChoosed = f.choosed | (1L << k);
                long newRemoved = f.removed | (1L << k);
                long newCovered = f.covered | (1L << k) | g[k];
                stack.push(new Frame(newChoosed, newRemoved, newCovered, 0, -1));

                continue;

                f.action = 3;
                long newRemoved = f.removed | (1L << f.k);
                stack.push(new Frame(f.choosed, newRemoved, f.covered, 0, -1));
                continue;
            } else if (f.action == 3) {
                stack.pop();
                continue;
            }
        }
    }

    class Frame {
        long choosed, removed, covered;
        int action;
        int k;
        Frame(long choosed, long removed, long covered, int action, int k) {
            this.choosed = choosed;
            this.removed = removed;
            this.covered = covered;
            this.action = action;
            this.k = k;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new P111C_v3().run();
    }
}
